title: Lab 03 — AWS Managed AI Services Tour
description: Use Amazon Comprehend, Translate, Polly, Transcribe and Rekognition from the console, and learn to match each managed AI service to a business use case.

steps.title: Step 1: Extract meaning from text with Amazon Comprehend
Step 2: Translate text with Amazon Translate
Step 3: Synthesise speech with Amazon Polly
Step 4: Convert speech to text with Amazon Transcribe
Step 5: Analyse images with Amazon Rekognition
Step 6: Match services to use cases
